judge.rationale: The candidate implements the basic WebSocket conversation list flow off the per-session lock, but diverges from the issue specification on almost every specific contract. It invents its own message and type names (`list_sessions` / `session_list` / `ListSessionsMessage` / `SessionListMessage` with `sessions` instead of `list_conversations` / `conversation_list` / `ListConversationsMessage` / `ConversationListMessage` with `conversations`). It completely omits the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in config and the `UNSUPPORTED` error code, instead enabling the feature unconditionally and returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when `listFor` is missing—directly violating the requirement to return an `UNSUPPORTED` error and never an empty list. Additionally, `validateMessage` allows `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` (whereas the ticket requires 1–200), the handler logs raw store error messages (which the ticket and GDPR rules forbid), and updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md` are missing.
